summary: Unified the system's memory architecture with high-performance vector storage and optimized reasoning workflows. Integrated asynchronous FastAPI optimizations and CI/CD automation with advanced self-consistency sampling and majority voting to reduce logic hallucinations and improve operational reliability.
key_learnings: Binary quantization and sqlite-vec facilitate high-performance vector storage with minimal overhead.
Quantitative evaluation (RAGAS-lite) is essential to detect signal loss during memory compression.
Synchronous I/O and CPU-bound tasks must be offloaded to prevent event loop stalls.
Self-consistency sampling improves reasoning reliability, while early-exit strategies manage computational costs.
Automating system agility requires a combination of strict versioning standards and structural output constraints.
